final_draft.answer: Yes. New EBS disks in our AWS account (111122223333) are encrypted by default. A live check on 2026-11-17 confirmed this setting in the us-east-1 region.
final_draft.note: The live check covers only the configured region, us-east-1. It does not show whether default encryption is on in any other region the account may use, so the answer does not claim that. The approved answer on disk encryption doesn't call account 111122223333 the production account. A separate approved answer on root MFA (answer:e28e1da1-725d-4728-bb80-66999e332323) does call it that. Please confirm this is the production account the customer is asking about.
